text:
I could not verify any award that *Avatar: The Last Airbender* won in 2006. The closest matches are 2007 ceremonies honoring its 2006 season (Book Two): Best Character Animation in a Television Production and Best Directing at the 34th Annie Awards ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avatar:_The_Last_Airbender_season_2)), and Outstanding Individual Achievement in Animation at the 2007 Primetime Emmys ([Emmys.com](https://www.emmys.com/awards/nominees-winners/2007/outstanding-short-format-animated-program)). If a 2006 win exists, it would most likely be a Kids' Choice or Peabody award, but the search results gave no years for those, so I can't confirm either.

CONFIDENCE: 30
